source: NAHB/Wells Fargo Housing Market Index, Nov. 2026

headline: Builder mood hits
a *14-year low*
slides.fig_caption: NAHB/Wells Fargo builder sentiment index, November 2026. The lowest reading since April 2012.
slides.sub: Down 4 points in a month as mortgage rates above 7% keep buyers on the sidelines.

slides.label: of builders *cut prices* in November
slides.body: That's the highest share of the post-Covid period. The typical cut held at 6% for the eighth straight month.

slides.label: of builders offered *sales incentives*
slides.body: Another post-Covid high, and the 20th month in a row at 60% or more.

slides.title: Sentiment *by region*
slides.note: Three-month averages. All four regions slipped, and buyer traffic fell to *16*, a 15-year low outside April 2020.

slides.title: Builders are *ready to deal*
slides.body: With 46% of builders cutting prices and 68% offering incentives, new construction deserves a fresh look for buyer clients. Ask what's on the table and compare it with resale options.
